data.notes_barbara:
Partial product overlap; Overlapping HR buyers; Different revenue model

HealthEquity overlaps in employer benefits administration. Its HSA custody and account-fee model differs from a full payroll/HCM platform.
data.notes_matthew: HealthEquity sells HSAs (health savings accounts) and benefits administration to employer benefits teams, so it's the same human resources buyer. But most of its revenue comes from custodial fees and card interchange fees, not software, so it's adjacent rather than direct.

data.reason: Health savings account custody and administration, a benefits and financial account business rather than payroll software.
Health savings account custodian earning account and interchange fees; not payroll or HCM software.

Both sell to US employers and touch benefits administration. Paylocity is a unified HCM/payroll software platform (payroll, HR, tax filing, finance and IT). HealthEquity is an HSA/FSA/HRA/COBRA account custodian and benefits administrator. The products overlap only at the edge (benefits administration). Customers overlap (employers), but HealthEquity also sells to health plans and individual account holders. Both earn some float or interest income, but HealthEquity's fees come mainly from account custody and transactions, not software subscriptions.
Both serve employers and employees, but HealthEquity administers health savings and benefits accounts rather than the supplied target's HR and payroll software.

data.offering_description: Provides custodial services and platforms for health savings accounts (HSAs), plus FSA, HRA, COBRA and commuter benefit administration. Serves employers, health plans, brokers and individual account holders. Earns money from custodial, interchange and service fees, and offers investment options to members.

data.primary_products: health savings accounts; investment platform for HSA balances; benefits debit cards

data.primary_services: HSA custodial services; consumer-directed benefit administration (FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter); member education and support

data.end_markets: healthcare benefits; employee benefits administration; financial services; retirement and savings

data.revenue_model: service fees: monthly account and administration fees from employers, plans and members; transaction or usage fees: interchange fees on card purchases; interest or premiums: custodial cash balances placed with banks and interest on deposits; commissions or management fees: investment fees on member HSA investments

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: HSA custodian holding member funds, working with employers, health plans and partner banks; service provider: administers consumer-directed benefits for employers and plans

data.geography_served: US national: Members and employers across the United States

data.regulatory_exposure: high: HSA non-bank custodian regulated by IRS and Treasury rules, also ERISA, DOL, HIPAA and CFPB oversight
